## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Search | search | q (name, email, ID prefix usr_) | debounced 300 ms; exact ID jumps to USR-03 | GtkSearchEntry |
| Status filter | chips | status active \ | invited \ | GtkToggleButton pills |
| More filters | menu | application_id, organization_id, created range |  | GtkMenuButton |
| Columns | table | display name + email, status, id, last_login_at, created_at | sortable client-side within loaded page; server order = created_at desc | GtkColumnView .data-table |
| Multi-select | selection |  | bulk: Suspend, Resend invitation, Export CSV (client-side of loaded rows) | AdwComboRow |
| Invite user | primary-button | → USR-02 | users.manage | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Open row | `→ USR-03` |  |
| Row menu |  | Suspend · Reactivate · Resend invitation · Copy ID · Copy email |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users?limit=50&cursor&status&q&application_id&organization_id&created_after&created_before`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
